name: Lockheed Martin CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Lockheed Martin Corp. is a worldwide security and aerospace firm that researches, designs, develops, manufactures, integrates and sustains technology systems, products and services. Its segments are Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems, and Space. Aeronautics covers advanced military aircraft, among them combat and air mobility planes and unmanned air vehicles.
